emotional_archetype: The Performance Pro & Dutch Precision Garage
context_strategy: High-density automotive workshop dashboard with folder-based kenteken management, mechanic workflow tracking, and customer history transparency. Styled strictly to match the Merkanic.nl brand identity.

rules.headings: Bold uppercase sans headings paired with italic red serif for signature brand contrast (e.g., 'Goed voor je auto. Helder voor jou.').
rules.eyebrow_labels: Small uppercase text with tracking-widest (e.g. '03 / KLANTENPORTAAL' or '01 / WERKORDERS'), font-semibold text-[#C0474A] or slate-500.
rules.kenteken_badge: inline-flex items-center bg-[#FACC15] text-[#0F172A] border-2 border-[#1E293B] font-mono font-black tracking-wider px-3 py-1 rounded-md shadow-sm uppercase select-none

layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Generous spacing system (p-6, p-8, p-12) with 1px precise crisp borders.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: 3-column responsive mosaic: Left sidebar nav + main content area (Werkorders Kanban/Table / Vehicle Folders / Form).
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: Internal padding p-6 or p-8 for all cards to prevent collision with borders.

key_features_to_build.description: Log in & Registreren switch for Klant, Monteur, and Beheerder. Mechanics registering via email enter 'Wacht op goedkeuring' (Pending Approval) state until Admin approves them from the Gebruikersbeheer panel.

High density operational overview with filter chips (Alle, Gepland, In behandeling, Wacht op onderdelen, Gereed, Afgehaald), search by kenteken or customer, and stats cards (Actieve werkorders, Vandaag gereed, Wacht op onderdelen, Totaal voertuigen).

Folder hierarchy UI for vehicles grouped by license plate (e.g. 1-ABC-23). Clicking a kenteken folder opens details: RDW specs card, folder list of orders ('Order 1: Oliewissel & APK', 'Order 2: Bandenwissel'), and historic maintenance timeline with photos and mechanic logs.

Form with Kenteken lookup (RDW simulation button or selection from customer car list), Km-stand input, standard template picker (Grote Beurt, Kleine Beurt, APK, Bandenwissel, Diagnose, Vrij), monteur assignment, status selector, and internal notes toggle.

Detail view with interactive checklist loaded from template (mark items done/pending), mechanic status changer, assigned mechanic dropdown, internal notes vs public customer notes thread, and repair photo attachment simulation.
Customer dashboard showing 'Mijn Auto's', active service status with progress indicator, past invoices & repair history per kenteken folder, mechanic notes, and easy 'Afspraak Inplannen' button.
Admin screen to approve/reject pending mechanic registrations, change roles (Klant, Monteur, Beheerder), and inspect user activity.

component_strategy.structure: React components with Tailwind CSS & Lucide icons
component_strategy.dialogs_and_modals: Shadcn Dialog / Modal components for quick werkorder creation and user approval
component_strategy.toast_notifications: Sonner toast notifications for status updates and order actions
component_strategy.tabs: Shadcn Tabs with h-auto override for navigation between Werkorders, Voertuigen Mappen, Nieuwe Order, Monteur Status, Gebruikersbeheer
component_strategy.license_plate_component:
Dutch License Plate Component: `
NL
{kenteken}
`

testing_and_data_testids.rules: Every interactive element must contain data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Dutch language is used for all visible strings: 'Werkorders', 'Voertuigen Mappen', 'Kenteken', 'KM Stand', 'Monteur Status', 'Grote Beurt', 'Kleine Beurt', 'APK Keuring', 'Bandenwissel', 'Opmerkingen', 'Wacht op goedkeuring'.
Integrate the Merkanic brand aesthetic: slate light background (#F8FAFC), crisp borders (#E2E8F0), Merkanic Red accent (#C0474A), and yellow Dutch license plate styling for kentekens.
Implement the full Monteur email registration + pending approval state ('Wacht op goedkeuring') with Admin approval controls.
Build the Voertuigen Mappen system where orders are grouped inside kenteken folders (Order 1, Order 2, etc.) and complete service history is displayed.
Provide interactive status changes, template-based dynamic checklists, and internal mechanic notes.
